summary: Repair exactly the findings the preflight named, and no more: give ArtifactEnvelope a contract and point the registry at it, declare path_base in the registry, declare tool authority in pmcro-orchestrator and create-skill frontmatter, and teach the Orchestrator skill about the runtime scripts it now owns.
